items.title: Relative associated points under base change are the associated points upstairs together with generic points of the residue field tensor products
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the relative associated points after an arbitrary base change for a morphism locally of finite type: a point upstairs is associated relative to the new base exactly when its image downstairs is associated relative to the old base and the point is a generic point of an irreducible component of the tensor product of the two residue fields (statement lines 1119-1138). The counted proof is a genuine reduction: it passes to the morphism between the fibres, which is flat because it is a base change along a field extension, applies the same-chapter decomposition of associated points over a locally Noetherian base to write the associated points of the fibre upstairs as a union indexed by those of the fibre downstairs, and then identifies the fibre of the fibrewise morphism at a point with the spectrum of the residue field tensor product, whose associated primes are its minimal primes by the cited Noetherian Cohen-Macaulay statement (proof lines 1140-1167). It is H2: the reduction is carried out in the counted span, with the cited inputs being standard fibre, decomposition and algebra facts.
